projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort, and R857 is Identified with mitigation status Assessed (EMS).
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may exceed remaining capacity and require timeline extension or resource augmentation.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery commitments to the client could slip, eroding trust and potentially triggering commercial renegotiation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal scope change evaluation and approval procedure with impact assessment before accepting new requests.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon further scope additions exceeding capacity, rebaseline impacted deliverables with Premera and agree phased delivery.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward from open EMS risk R857 (Identified, Moderate, Likely, Medium) and re-rated based on cumulative scope absorption already equivalent to nearly one sprint. Mitigation plan not yet finalized (EMS).

riskDescription.context: The go-green plan documents Citrix slowness and frequent disconnections impacting delivery, with a ticket to be raised with Premera to address the issue (EMS).
riskDescription.condition: Persistent Citrix instability may continue to degrade developer productivity and collaboration effectiveness.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity could decline, increasing the likelihood of timeline pressure and quality shortcuts.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise Premera ticket to analyze and resolve Citrix slowness and disconnections impacting developer productivity.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When connectivity issues cause two-hour daily loss, restart VDI sessions and escalate to Premera infrastructure team.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from EMS go-green plan; ticket not yet raised, so resolution timeline and client responsiveness unknown. Impact on delivery explicitly noted (EMS).

riskDescription.context: Azure 4xx/5xx alert false-positives required retry logic updates to classify invalid email-format failures as non-retryable, with deployment and validation in Production still pending (EMS).
riskDescription.condition: Until the updated retry logic is deployed and validated, false-positive P4 incidents may continue to mask genuine failures or consume support effort.
riskDescription.consequence: Real production issues could be missed or delayed in detection, weakening operational stability and client confidence.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Deploy updated retry logic to Production and validate alert accuracy during Hypercare monitoring before re-enabling alerts.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should false-positive incidents persist post-deployment, implement manual alert triage and notify Premera of monitoring gaps.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from EMS go-green plan; deployment and validation not yet complete, so risk remains open. Hypercare monitoring planned but not yet confirmed effective (EMS).
